outline: The course deals with the evolution of the city and the formation of urban settlement. Cities with various historical and cultural significance will be discussed, as well as the issues of aesthetics, urbanism and globalization. The students will obtain basic knowledge concerning the development of the city of the twenty-first century.
schedule:
week1:
The beginning of the human settlement
week2:
The utopia and dystopia-- from Thomas More to ”Blade Runner”
week3:
The architecture of the city-- from Aldo Rossi to Manfredo Tafuri
week4:
The modernity and modern city-- from Wright to Le Corbusier
week5:
The rationality and romanticism-- Thomas Jefferson and American dream
week6:
The myth of grid-- from Greek city to New York
week7:
The city of movement and mobility-- the Los Angeles
week8:
The city of poetry-- from Florence to Venice
week9:
The city of ideology-- Rome and Berlin
week10:
The Kafka's worry-- the urban renewal since Baron Haussmann
week11:
The mutation of the city-- the idea of Rem Koolhaas
week12:
The spirit of the city-- concerning the ”genius loci”
week13:
The place and space-- the viewpoint of cultural geography
week14:
The space of flow-- from David Harvey to Manuel Castell
week 15:
The formation of oriental city 1
week16:
The formation of oriental city 2
week17:
The community and city--from Jane Jacobs to Lewis Mumford
